Name: Axolotls in Stardew Valley
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
wild axolotl populations are making a comeback, specifically in Pelican Town! (for some reason)
grab a fishing rod, head to the mountain lake and catch yourself an axolotl today ♡

≽(◕ ᴗ ◕)≼

[b][size=4]3.0.0 update:
[/size][/b]♡ added baby axolotls! pond axolotls have a chance of producing them and you can sell them for a pretty penny and/or put them in fish tanks. (side note: the babies do not count as fish so you don't have to worry about getting them all for your fish collection)[b]
[/b]♡ added animations
♡ made axolotls available only in spring/summer rather than all seasons
♡ adjusted axolotls sell price and spawn rate

[b][size=4][img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
[/size][/b]1. download and install content patcher and json assets (and content patcher animations if you want the axolotls animated)
2. download this mod
3. unzip folder into the stardew mods folder

[b][size=4][img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img][/size][/b]
♡ sprites made by me
♡ help wanted board used in the first picture is from the "starry sky interface" mod and edited by me
